description: ADR-0120 cross-Worker parity gate for the run-page capability token. The relay (apps/relay/src/fleet-run-page.ts runPageToken) VERIFIES what the fleet-executor (apps/fleet-executor/src/run-page.ts runPageToken) MINTS: hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, runId)). The two Workers deploy separately and each hand-implements the function, so both test suites assert these exact vectors — a divergence in either copy fails that app's CI. Regenerating these values to make a failing implementation pass is a security-relevant change; review it like a change to the verifier itself.
